basis.normalised: cx, cy = box centre over the texture (or Garland photo) width and height; size = side over width; sizeH = side over height
basis.curated: game art: {eyes: [u, v], chin: v} in hr texture fractions (PortraitFraming.CropFor: eyes on 0.44, chin on 0.81, clamped to the texture and the card art bounds); pack: photoBox [x, y, side] in Garland photo px

teamBases.A: suggestedCrop eyes/chin in texture fractions; faceOffset eyeX%/eyeY%/chinY% in % of the current crop window
teamBases.B: fix-option eyes/chin in texture fractions; "today the eyes sit at" figures in plate %
teamBases.C: game landmarks in texture fractions; pack landmarks in plate fractions of the 128 px image in findings.json and photo fractions in review.json

calibration.gameChin: Team C's detector chin sits at or below the jaw on painted art; the true chin is eye + 0.87 x (detector chin - eye) (median of 18 hand readings, range 0.80-1.03). Team A's chin readings on curated plates follow the curated chin, which on most cards sits on the mouth (see changes.json, finding F1).
calibration.packChin: On Garland 3D renders Team C's chin is the true chin (8 of 8 checked); no correction.
calibration.packSystemic: current pack crops: median eye line 0.574, chin 0.87 (Team C): the builder fix (code change C3) moves the box down about 0.134 of its side

meta.confidenceFormula: 0.20 detector + 0.25 detector agreement + 0.20 visual + 0.15 plausibility + 0.20 teams (Team C's four terms rescaled to 0.8, plus how closely each team's bias-corrected measurement agrees with the final: 1 within 0.05 of the plate and 10 % in size, falling to 0 at 0.15 and 30 %; one team only caps it at 0.8; no team 0.25 for a fresh detection, 0 otherwise)
